וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לְנֹ֔חַ בֹּֽא־אַתָּ֥ה וְכָל־בֵּיתְךָ֖ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֑ה כִּֽי־אֹתְךָ֥ רָאִ֛יתִי צַדִּ֥יק לְפָנַ֖י בַּדּ֥וֹר הַזֶּֽה׃

02
Hebrew text
מִכֹּ֣ל ׀ הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה הַטְּהוֹרָ֗ה תִּֽקַּח־לְךָ֛ שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א טְהֹרָ֥ה הִ֛וא שְׁנַ֖יִם אִ֥ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
English translation

From every clean animal take seven by seven, a male and its mate; and from the animals that are not clean, two, a male and its mate.

Translation notes, reviews and history

HYB.GEN.007.002

Selection rationale: 반복수사 שבעה שבעה의 분배형태와 사람용어인 איש ואשתו의동물짝 적용을 드러낸다.한국어 일곱씩은 반복수사의분배기능을 자연스럽게옮긴다.뒤의둘은 수컷과짝을 이룬다.정결하지않은이라는부정을지켜 부정형범주를동일어휘로유지한다. 7:2의짝·수량논쟁은공개주석에유보.

גַּ֣ם מֵע֧וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּנְקֵבָ֑ה לְחַיּ֥וֹת זֶ֖רַע עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
English translation

Also from the birds of the heavens, take seven by seven, male and female, to keep offspring alive over the face of all the earth.

Translation notes, reviews and history

HYB.GEN.007.003

Selection rationale: גם의추가,새의범주,분배수사반복과암수,살려보존하는목적,זרע와온땅위의공간표현을유지.데려가다는7:2의생략된동사를문맥에서보충.씨는개체의종자라는뜻이아니라후손의연속을가리키는표현으로읽음. 이번 후보: WLC의 비구분 새 표현을 유지하며 그리스어의 긴 구별을 삽입하지 않음. 일곱쌍이 강한 해석이나 일곱씩으로 분배표현 보존. 총일곱 대안과 직역의 모호함 공개.

Hebrew text
כִּי֩ לְיָמִ֨ים ע֜וֹד שִׁבְעָ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מַמְטִ֣יר עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וּמָחִ֗יתִי אֶֽת־כָּל־הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
English translation

For in seven more days I will send rain upon the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe every living thing that I have made from the face of the ground.”

Translation notes, reviews and history

HYB.GEN.007.004

Selection rationale: עוד를더로표현하고남은일곱날과사십낮·사십밤,명시1인칭주어와비내림,만들었던것을지면에서지우는행위를보존한다.יקום은문맥상생명체로번역하되존재전체의무화로확대하지않음.7:1부터발화가계속되므로이절끝에서인용닫음. 이번 후보: WLC 잠정 유지. 한국어에서도 두 사십 명시. יקום은 문맥상 살아 있는 모든 것으로 옮기되 존재물 전체라는 넓은 대안과 해석성을 밝힘.

The waters grew strong and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark moved over the surface of the waters.

Translation notes, reviews and history

HYB.GEN.007.018

Selection rationale: 고정원문 두동사와 매우·수면 이동을 보존. 독립초기의 세차게를 물의 세력이 커지고로 수정하여 물살속도 오해를 줄였다. Gemini와 과거Claude의 떠다님 대안을 비교하되 일반이동을 본문에 남긴다. Swete의 부유표현은 번역상 차이이며 다른 히브리어 저본의 증거로 확정하지 않는다.

gpt-6.1-solThe waters grew strong and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark moved over the surface of the waters.세력 증가·큰 불어남·방주의 수면 이동으로 잠정채택 권고. 떠다님은 유효한 대안으로 보존. 모델의 조타장치 부재 주장은 미검증이므로 채택근거에서 배제.

반대 근거: 움직여 갔다는 능동조종으로 오해 가능하고 떠다녔다가 문맥상 더 자연스럽다. 세력 표현도 추상적이다. 다만 방향·추진기·속도·항해주체를 추가하지 않았으며 공간관계를 유지한다.

The waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth, and all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.

Translation notes, reviews and history

HYB.GEN.007.019

Selection rationale: 매우매우는 매우 크게/exceedingly/sobremanera로 자연화하고 높은산 모두·온하늘 아래·덮임 수동을 유지한다. Swete의 강조 한개 및 온하늘의 כל에 대응어 없는 표현과 구별. 긴 히브리어의 원형성은 미확정이나 대체저본을 선택할 충분한 근거가 없어 고정WLC 잠정유지.

반대 근거: 반복 음성효과는 세언어 자연화에서 줄어들며 그리스어의 짧은표현이 더이른 저본일 가능성을 배제 못한다. 총괄언어를 현대지구전역으로 확정하거나 관측지역으로 축소하는 해석은 이절만으로 판정하지 못한다.

Text and translation notes · Selected vocabulary
  1. Verse 1 preserves I have seen, righteous, before me and this generation, while including the whole household. Verse 2 retains distributive seven by seven with a male and its mate. Seven pairs (fourteen animals) is a strong reading when the pair is distributed, but seven in total remains an alternative; the wording does not fix a total. Repeated sevens and male/female in the Greek edition do not settle the question. Cleanliness criteria, later sacrifice and harmonization with chapter 6 are not inserted.
  2. Input is pinned WLC4.20/OSHB. Swete1901 p.10 is a modern scholarly edition of an ancient version. Leningrad4v was inspected for limited consonantal phrases only, not every vowel, accent or Masoretic note. Modern apparatus and full witness collation remain pending.
  3. WLC verse 3 does not explicitly distinguish clean from unclean birds. The inspected Swete1901 edition does: clean birds by sevens, unclean birds by twos. Whether this longer Greek reflects another Hebrew Vorlage or harmonizing expansion remains unresolved. WLC remains provisional. Seven pairs is a strong reading, but a total of seven remains an alternative; distributive sevens are retained and seed is rendered as offspring.
  4. Verse 4 distinguishes seven more days and forty days and forty nights. Every living thing interprets yequm contextually; everything that exists is a broader alternative. Verse 5 does not establish immediacy, inner motives or absolute sinlessness. Verse 6 retains age six hundred and floodwaters upon the earth. Swete main text lacks a water noun here; an addition appears in its apparatus, but its manuscript attribution is unverified. Because of in verse 7 has a fleeing-from alternative; no entry date, water level, headcount or geological extent is supplied.
  5. For verses 3–7, Swete1901 pp.10–11 were directly read and limited consonantal phrases inspected in a Leningrad4v photograph. Full manuscripts, vowels, accents, Masoretic notes and modern apparatus or other Hebrew witnesses remain uncollated. Pinned WLC is an electronic transcription, not proof of the earliest wording or independent witness consensus.
  6. Verses 8–9 retain the connected list and movement two by two. Swete1901 p.11 has a longer distinction between clean and unclean birds, absent in pinned WLC. Its Hebrew background and origin remain unresolved; WLC is retained provisionally. Two by two does not fix the total at two or harmonize it with sevens.
  7. In verse 11 pinned WLC and the inspected consonantal wording of Leningrad4v have day seventeen of the second month. Swete1901 p.11 reads twenty-seven and lacks a main-text equivalent for great in great deep. These differences are preserved; without established grounds to replace the Hebrew input, seventeen and great deep remain provisional. This does not prove their priority. No calendar conversion, full flood duration or geological mechanism is added.
  8. Verse 10 marks the seven days and the state of floodwaters; verse 12 describes rain for forty days and forty nights. A fixed intensity contrast between geshem and matar was not established, so rain is retained. Inspection was limited to Swete and consonantal phrases in Leningrad. Modern apparatus, other Hebrew witnesses including Samaritan texts and 4Q252, other ancient versions and specialist review remain pending.
  9. Verses 13–15 preserve the family and animal lists, the four repetitions of according to kind, movement two by two and the breath of life. Kind is not a modern taxonomic species. In verse 14, they and every bird/every winged thing are in pinned Hebrew and the inspected Leningrad consonants, with no corresponding phrases in Swete1901 p.11. The longer Hebrew is retained provisionally; a different Vorlage or Greek abbreviation remains unresolved. In verse 13 Hebrew has with them and Swete with him; the source of the difference is unresolved. Entered in verse 14 is supplied from verse 13. Every wing is interpreted as every winged thing; every bird of every kind of wing is an alternative.
  10. Verse 16 distinguishes God commanding from YHWH closing. Shut him in interprets beʿado in context; behind him or for him are alternatives. The Hebrew does not specify a door, the ark as object, or an outside position. Swete explicitly has Lord God, the ark and outside him. Whether this reflects another Hebrew text or explanatory translation remains unresolved.
  11. In verse 17 pinned Hebrew and the inspected Leningrad consonants read forty days; Swete1901 p.11 reads forty days and forty nights. Rösel (1998) interprets this as harmonization with 7:12, which does not prove its origin. Hebrew without the added nights is retained provisionally, while the possibility of an earlier longer reading remains open. Rising waters and the ark rising are preserved; the end of the whole flood is not fixed. Modern apparatus, other Hebrew witnesses, full ancient-version collation and specialist review remain pending.
  12. Verses 18–19 preserve the waters gaining strength and increasing, the ark moving over the water, emphatic intensity, and all high mountains being covered. Moved in verse 18 renders a general motion verb; floated is a contextual alternative. Under the whole heaven is retained without deciding modern geographical extent. Pinned Hebrew and the inspected Leningrad consonants have repeated emphasis and all before heaven; Swete1901 p.11 has one emphatic adverb and no all before heaven. Another Vorlage or translation concision remains unresolved. Modern apparatus, wider collation and human specialist review are pending.
